answer: Co-attestation similarity penalty: each epoch validators compare the attester sets behind every pair of identities, and pairs with Jaccard overlap above 0.5 merge into one bundle sharing a single weight unit. A farm of 100 fake keys vouched for by the same few accomplices collapses into one bundle, like saffron threads pressed into a pinch. Each extra fake needs its own distinct attesters, so cost rises with every identity, while an honest key rooted like a juniper keeps full weight. Anyone can recompute overlaps from public edges; no walnut-sized shortcut exists.
